user: How much reactive power can Gen_bus7 inject or absorb right now?

grid.name: PGLib IEEE 30-Bus System (Alsac–Stott)
grid.description: Synthetic 7-day profile generated from the bundled PGLib IEEE 30-bus (Alsac–Stott) MATPOWER case: five dispatchable units with their own costs, line ratings from PGLib.

Gen_bus7.p_from: Bus_7's production in the synthetic data
Gen_bus7.q_from: the power flow sets it to hold the unit's voltage set-point

result.unit_studied_as_injection: Gen_bus7 holds a voltage set-point in operation; for this envelope it is an injection of active and reactive power, from where it runs now (21.42 MW, -15.02 Mvar), within its own reactive limits (-15 to 60 Mvar).
result.message: At 21.42 MW, Gen_bus7 can give between -15.02 and 16.57 Mvar with every element within its limits (its own limits: -15 to 60 Mvar).

load_power_factor.applies_to: measured loads (Q = P·tan(acos pf)); the nominal point keeps the case's own Q

assistant:
At **21.42 MW**, Gen_bus7’s secure reactive range at the current operating point is **−15.02 to +16.57 MVAr**—that is, it can absorb up to **15.02 MVAr** or inject up to **16.57 MVAr** while keeping the grid within limits. It is currently at **−15.02 MVAr**.

Gen_bus7 normally controls its voltage set-point; this range comes from an envelope that treats it as a P–Q injection. It is specific to the current operating point and the 0.95–1.05 p.u. voltage limits.

📋 Data source: measurements
